# Thickness

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Stores the top, right, bottom, and left values of padding or a margin.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Thickness(all: number)
new Thickness(horizontal: number, vertical: number)
new Thickness(left: number, top: number, right: number, bottom: number)
```

## Properties

- [`bottom`](#bottom): Thickness on the bottom side, in points.
- [`left`](#left): Thickness on the left side, in points.
- [`right`](#right): Thickness on the right side, in points.
- [`top`](#top): Thickness on the top side, in points.
